response.sql: WITH telescope_counts AS (SELECT telescref, COUNT(*) AS signal_count FROM signals GROUP BY telescref), ranked AS (SELECT telescref, signal_count, CAST(signal_count AS REAL) / SUM(signal_count) OVER () AS fraction, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY signal_count DESC) AS signal_rank FROM telescope_counts) SELECT telescref, signal_count, fraction FROM ranked WHERE signal_rank <= 10 ORDER BY fraction DESC, telescref;
